design_philosophy.core: A high-end, function-first AI builder interface inspired by app.emergent.sh. It uses a liquid responsive split-screen layout designed for a chat-first workflow with real-time preview.
rules: Avoid generic SaaS gradients. Use stark contrasts, fine 1px borders, and generous padding.
UI must support Right-to-Left (RTL) natively as the core content is in Arabic.
The entire app should feel like a unified full-page IDE/builder workspace, not a scrolling landing page.
Optical clarity is key: Use 'Crystal Glass' for floating elements and solid backgrounds for main panels.

language_support.note: Apply dir='rtl' on the root HTML/body or main layout wrapper to correctly render Arabic text. Ensure all padding/margins use logical properties (e.g., ps, pe, ms, me) or are mirrored for RTL.

layout_and_spacing.app_shell: h-screen w-full flex flex-col md:flex-row overflow-hidden bg-zinc-50
layout_and_spacing.sidebar_or_chat_panel: w-full md:w-[400px] lg:w-[480px] h-[50vh] md:h-full flex flex-col border-e border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/80 shrink-0
layout_and_spacing.workspace_preview: flex-1 h-[50vh] md:h-full flex flex-col bg-white relative overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 inside panels. Gap-4 for dense UI elements like chat bubbles, Gap-8 for major layout sections.
layout_and_spacing.step_progress: A horizontal or vertical stepper indicating the current specialized agent phase.

components.chat_input: Sticky at the bottom of the chat panel. Should have a solid background (bg-white), rounded-xl, 1px border-zinc-200, shadow-sm. Use a textarea that auto-resizes. Send button should be an icon inside the input.
components.chat_message: Flex layout. AI messages left-aligned (or right-aligned in RTL), User messages opposite. Include agent avatar/icon. Add Framer Motion 'layout' for smooth list updates.
components.agent_selector: A visually distinct card or dropdown that shows the current active agent. Can use the provided abstract image textures as a subtle header background for the agent's profile.
components.stepper: Step-by-step indicator showing: 1. التحليل (Analysis), 2. التعديل (Edit), 3. التوليد (Generate), 4. الكتابة (Write). Active step is bold text + solid dot, inactive steps are gray text + outlined dot.
components.workspace_pane: A blank canvas area on the opposite side of the chat. Includes a top toolbar with 'Preview', 'Code', 'Export' segmented controls. Content dynamically changes based on the active step (e.g., showing a generated document, code, or charts).

motion.transitions: Use spring animations for layout shifts (e.g., changing from Chat to Settings route).
motion.chat: Messages should slide up and fade in: { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 10 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.3 } }
motion.workspace: Crossfade content in the workspace pane when the agent step changes.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use Phoshor Icons (Duotone or Regular) for UI elements. Chat bubble, Robot, Sparkle, Code, Eye, PaperPlaneRight.

agent_analysis.description: Close up shiny metal surface. Use as an avatar background or profile header for the 'Analysis' (التحليل) Agent.

agent_edit.description: Black and white curved metal surface. Use as an avatar background or profile header for the 'Edit' (التعديل) Agent.

agent_generate.description: Abstract metallic sculpture with flowing shapes. Use as an avatar background or profile header for the 'Generate' (التوليد) Agent.

agent_write.description: Abstract metallic sculpture with pink and gray colors. Use as an avatar background or profile header for the 'Write' (الكتابة) Agent.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI as a full-screen application ('h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden') with two main columns: a Chat Panel (collapsible on mobile) and a Workspace Preview Panel.
Ensure RTL (Right-to-Left) layout is fully implemented by default using `<html dir='rtl'>` or applying RTL standard Tailwind practices (using ms, me, ps, pe, text-start).
Create a Step-by-Step progress component inside the Chat Panel or top header. The steps MUST be in Arabic: 1. التحليل (Analysis), 2. التعديل (Edit), 3. التوليد (Generate), 4. الكتابة (Write).
Each step corresponds to a 'Specialized Agent' chatting with the user. Show which agent is currently active.

Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to match the Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast) look—remove excessive border radii (use rounded-md or rounded-none) and remove soft shadows (use sharp 1px borders).
The Workspace Preview panel should display dynamic mock content based on the step (e.g., data charts during Analysis, a text editor during Edit/Write, a UI preview during Generate).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
